CREATE TABLE users (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	hashed_password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	full_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	role userrole NOT NULL, 
	hourly_rate NUMERIC(10, 2), 
	cost_per_hour NUMERIC(10, 2) DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	available_hours_month NUMERIC(5, 1) DEFAULT '147' NOT NULL, 
	weekly_hours FLOAT NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	password_reset_required BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	invited_by INTEGER, 
	preferences JSONB DEFAULT '{}', 
	region VARCHAR(10), 
	locality VARCHAR(100), 
	short_name VARCHAR(50), 
	birthday DATE, 
	job_title VARCHAR(100), 
	morning_reminder_time VARCHAR(5) DEFAULT '08:00' NOT NULL, 
	evening_reminder_time VARCHAR(5) DEFAULT '18:00' NOT NULL, 
	onboarding_completed BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	google_refresh_token VARCHAR(500), 
	google_calendar_id VARCHAR(200), 
	google_calendar_synced_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	google_calendar_connected BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'false' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(invited_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_users_invited_by ON users (invited_by)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_email ON users (email)

CREATE TABLE clients (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR(255), 
	phone VARCHAR(50), 
	company VARCHAR(255), 
	website VARCHAR(255), 
	contract_type contracttype NOT NULL, 
	monthly_budget NUMERIC(12, 2), 
	status clientstatus NOT NULL, 
	notes TEXT, 
	cif VARCHAR(50), 
	currency VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	monthly_fee NUMERIC(12, 2), 
	holded_contact_id VARCHAR(100), 
	vat_number VARCHAR(50), 
	vat_treatment vattreatment DEFAULT 'domestic_21' NOT NULL, 
	ga4_property_id VARCHAR(50), 
	gsc_url VARCHAR(255), 
	billing_cycle billingcycle, 
	billing_day INTEGER, 
	next_invoice_date DATE, 
	last_invoiced_date DATE, 
	engine_project_id INTEGER, 
	is_internal BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	context TEXT, 
	intermediary_name VARCHAR(200), 
	is_intermediary_deal BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	business_model VARCHAR(50), 
	aov FLOAT, 
	conversion_rate FLOAT, 
	ltv FLOAT, 
	seo_maturity_level VARCHAR(20), 
	engine_content_count INTEGER, 
	engine_keyword_count INTEGER, 
	engine_avg_position FLOAT, 
	engine_clicks_30d INTEGER, 
	engine_impressions_30d INTEGER, 
	engine_metrics_synced_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	engine_summary_data JSONB, 
	engine_alerts_data JSONB, 
	onboarding_intelligence JSONB, 
	slack_template JSONB, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_client_monthly_budget_positive CHECK (monthly_budget >= 0)
)

CREATE TABLE task_categories (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	default_minutes INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (name)
)

CREATE TABLE service_templates (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	service_type servicetype NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	is_recurring BOOLEAN, 
	price_range_min NUMERIC(10, 2), 
	price_range_max NUMERIC(10, 2), 
	default_phases JSON, 
	default_includes TEXT, 
	default_excludes TEXT, 
	prompt_context TEXT, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (service_type)
)

CREATE TABLE monthly_closes (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	year INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	month INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_numbers BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_margin BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_cash_buffer BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

	reviewed_debt BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_taxes BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_personal BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	reviewed_holded BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

	description TEXT NOT NULL, 
	color VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL,

CREATE TABLE taxes (

)

)

CREATE TABLE projects (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	project_type VARCHAR(50), 
	start_date TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	target_end_date TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	actual_end_date TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	status projectstatus NOT NULL, 
	progress_percent INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	budget_hours FLOAT, 
	weekly_hours_budget FLOAT, 
	monthly_hours_budget FLOAT, 
	budget_amount NUMERIC(12, 2), 
	gsc_url VARCHAR(255), 
	ga4_property_id VARCHAR(50), 
	is_recurring BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	engine_project_id INTEGER, 
	pricing_model VARCHAR(20), 
	monthly_fee NUMERIC(12, 2), 
	fee_is_base BOOLEAN DEFAULT 'true' NOT NULL, 
	unit_price NUMERIC(12, 2), 
	unit_label VARCHAR(50), 
	scope TEXT, 
	billing_day INTEGER, 
	billing_amount NUMERIC(12, 2), 
	next_billing_date DATE, 
	last_billed_date DATE, 
	client_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	owner_id INTEGER, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_project_budget_amount_positive CHECK (budget_amount >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_project_budget_hours_positive CHECK (budget_hours >= 0), 
	FOREIGN KEY(client_id) REFERENCES clients (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_projects_owner_id ON projects (owner_id)
CREATE INDEX ix_projects_client_id ON projects (client_id)

	position VARCHAR(100), 
	is_primary BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

	department VARCHAR(100),

	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL,

	FOREIGN KEY(client_id) REFERENCES clients (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_client_contacts_client_id ON client_contacts (client_id)

CREATE TABLE client_resources (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	client_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	label VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	url VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	resource_type resourcetype NOT NULL,

	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL,

	invoice_number VARCHAR(100),

)
CREATE INDEX ix_billing_events_client_id ON billing_events (client_id)

CREATE TABLE invoices (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	invoice_number VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	amount NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL, 
	issued_date TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	paid BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	notes TEXT, 
	client_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (invoice_number), 
	FOREIGN KEY(client_id) REFERENCES clients (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_invoices_client_id ON invoices (client_id)

CREATE TABLE audit_logs (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL,

	entity_type VARCHAR(50), 
	entity_id INTEGER, 
	details TEXT, 
	method VARCHAR(10), 
	route_template VARCHAR(255), 
	status_code INTEGER, 
	duration_ms INTEGER, 
	user_id INTEGER, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_audit_logs_route_template ON audit_logs (route_template)
CREATE INDEX ix_audit_logs_user_id ON audit_logs (user_id)

	label VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	operations JSONB NOT NULL, 
	undone_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE,

	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(undone_by) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_change_logs_user_id ON change_logs (user_id)

CREATE TABLE alert_settings (

	days_without_activity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	days_before_deadline INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	days_without_contact INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	max_tasks_per_week INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	notify_in_app BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	notify_email BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL,

	UNIQUE (user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)

CREATE INDEX ix_user_permissions_user_id ON user_permissions (user_id)

	email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	token VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	role userrole NOT NULL, 
	invited_by INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	accepted_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL,

CREATE INDEX ix_user_invitations_invited_by ON user_invitations (invited_by)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_user_invitations_token ON user_invitations (token)

	client_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	period_start DATE NOT NULL, 
	period_end DATE NOT NULL, 
	status digeststatus NOT NULL, 
	tone digesttone NOT NULL, 
	content JSON, 
	raw_context JSON, 
	generated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	edited_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE,

CREATE INDEX ix_weekly_digests_created_by ON weekly_digests (created_by)
CREATE INDEX ix_weekly_digests_client_id ON weekly_digests (client_id)

	FOREIGN KEY(responsible_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE SET NULL

CREATE INDEX ix_client_report_policies_responsible_user_id ON client_report_policies (responsible_user_id)

	company_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	contact_name VARCHAR(200),

CREATE TABLE income (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	date DATE NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	amount NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	client_id INTEGER, 
	invoice_number VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	vat_rate NUMERIC(5, 2) NOT NULL, 
	vat_amount NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL, 
	tax_regime VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	irpf_withholding_rate NUMERIC(5, 2) NOT NULL, 
	irpf_withholding_amount NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	notes TEXT NOT NULL, 
	due_date DATE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_income_amount_non_negative CHECK (amount >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_income_vat_rate_range CHECK (vat_rate >= 0 AND vat_rate <= 100), 
	FOREIGN KEY(client_id) REFERENCES clients (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_income_client_id ON income (client_id)

CREATE TABLE expenses (

	date DATE NOT NULL, 
	description VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	amount NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL,

	irpf_withholding_amount NUMERIC(12, 2) NOT NULL, 
	supplier VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	notes TEXT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_expense_amount_non_negative CHECK (amount >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_expense_vat_rate_range CHECK (vat_rate >= 0 AND vat_rate <= 100), 
	FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES expense_categories (id)

CREATE INDEX ix_expenses_category_id ON expenses (category_id)

CREATE INDEX ix_advisor_ai_brief_payloads_brief_id ON advisor_ai_brief_payloads (brief_id)

	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	holded_id VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	client_id INTEGER, 
	contact_name VARCHAR(300), 
	invoice_number VARCHAR(100), 
	date DATE, 
	due_date DATE, 
	total NUMERIC(10, 2), 
	subtotal NUMERIC(10, 2), 
	tax NUMERIC(10, 2), 
	status VARCHAR(50), 
	currency VARCHAR(3), 
	raw_data JSON, 
	synced_at TIMESTAMP WITHOUT TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (holded_id),
